QUOTE: "`ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` (`:1158`) | detached async-ask worker" and "`run_async_ask` uses a detached `std::thread` that captures `this`. The index shows no join or ownership record for it."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as detached with no join or ownership record. It doesn't say it is the only detached thread, but it does say it has no join.
